note: MSL2 cohort studies and NMD-escape analyses demonstrate that both PTVs and missense variants cause a shared neurodevelopmental disorder with reduced MSL2 expression and overlapping core phenotype severity.

evidence.text: Karayol et al. identified a cohort of 25 individuals harboring heterozygous de novo missense or protein-truncating variants in MSL2, who shared core neurodevelopmental features including developmental delay, hypotonia, and dysmorphisms, with patient-derived iPSCs demonstrating reduced MSL2 levels and a common distinct DNA episignature.

source.title: MSL2 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with lack of coordination, epilepsy, specific dysmorphisms, and a distinct episignature
source.quote: Here we describe 25 individuals with heterozygous, missense, or protein-truncating variant alleles in MSL2, delineating genotypes and phenotypes

evidence.text: Systematic evaluation of truncating variants in neurodevelopmental cohorts identified frameshift and missense variants in MSL2 presenting with similar neurodevelopmental phenotypes.

source.title: Systematic analysis of variants escaping nonsense-mediated decay uncovers candidate Mendelian diseases
source.quote: Frameshift and missense variants in HDAC2 and MSL2 have … individuals with NDD similar to the missense individuals.
